The NHS generally speaking do a great job, but it's cowboys like Moulton Medical Centre that give it the bad name that it sometimes gets associated with.

I have never in all my years experienced service as bad as I have here at Moulton Medical Centre. The receptionists seems to have been specifically trained to disregard the use of manners, confidentiality and any kind of customer service. They are (with exception to perhaps one or two) incredibly rude, disrespectful and careless. Because it's your health, and not theirs, they do not care, and that notion seems to also filter its way through the surgery to the doctors themselves with their passive and lazy approach to administering medical care and medical management. If you question the receptionists' manners, lack of confidentiality or attitude on the phone when simply trying to have a conversation, you're met with increased hostility, rude remarks and threats on hanging up the phone.

I had the displeasure of having a medical issue for 8 months whilst at Moulton Medical centre, and not once in those 8 months did the doctor proactively prescribe something that could be of any help. Nothing prescribed in 8 months is bordering negligence.

I am luckily fortunate enough to own another property in a neighbouring county and have since left this practice, to join another GP, but I feel very sorry for anyone stuck here with no choice but to stay.

If you can, avoid this place like the plague, and I'd encourage others who have had to deal with this place to leave reviews as well, because it needs to be known how bad this place really is.

Moulton Medical Centre, do better.",null,[0,144]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25aT2RuTmFNSE5RVDBSRlFscEZhMmhyVm5oeFlYYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xfeb8824622bb6646!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnZOdnNaMHNQT0RFQlpFa2hrVnhxYXc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25aT2RuTmFNSE5RVDBSRlFscEZhMmhyVm5oeFlYYxAB&t=1&-KgswZFZxRVNmWVo1cQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi69MKsybCTAxUkI2MBHd3XBs0QoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi69MKsybCTAxUkI2MBHd3XBs0Q0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUJYZDJWWVpGOWZSV2hEYUdWV1JIZGFNMjlUYW5sbGVsaFlaMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRZDBOWk9XSkNOV1F3V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOUE1VeGpkWEo2V1hoMmMyRXpRbFkwTkZsYVkwRRAB",["0x0:0xfeb8824622bb6646",null,1766718286791804,1766718286791804,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106125970297716721530/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["sam louth","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJEKgMY_-nuqRkFrLY05t4n2UhwGKa_R-hE-nw83Cxc4VQkBg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106125970297716721530?hl=en"],"106125970297716721530",null,4,3,null,[0,3,1],0,["4 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi69MKsybCTAxUkI2MBHd3XBs0Q7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Terrible, some really rude staff and the paramedic they substitute the GP for without asking you is horrific.
